senses.zh_definition: 莉萝：迪士尼《星际宝贝》（Lilo & Stitch）中的夏威夷女孩。此释义仅适用于人物专名 Lilo，尚不能确定输入的小写词形是否指该人物。
senses.en_definition: Lilo, the Hawaiian girl in Disney’s Lilo & Stitch; a proper-name interpretation that remains unconfirmed for the supplied token.
senses.ms_definition: Nama khas bagi watak seorang kanak-kanak perempuan dari Hawaii dalam filem Disney Lilo & Stitch; tafsiran ini belum dapat dipastikan bagi token yang diberikan.
senses.nuances: 这是有来源支持的专名解读，并非已核实的马来语普通词义。专名首字母须大写；下列搭配与例句均基于此解读，属于编写的教学示例，未作语料频率断言。人物身份见 [Disney 官方电影介绍](https://movies.disney.com/lilo-stitch)。

etymology.historical_story: Lilo is documented as the name of the Hawaiian girl in Disney’s 2002 animated film Lilo & Stitch. The story connects her friendship with an alien to family and belonging. This establishes a cultural referent, rather than a Malay lexical origin. The supplied packet does not establish why this token occurs in its word list. [Disney’s original film page](https://movies.disney.com/lilo-stitch).
